query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 274.6995, -13.79, 0.0556)) AND parallax > 0 AND parallax_over_error >= 3 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 20.5 AND ruwe < 1.4
distance: inverse parallax: 1000 / parallax_mas parsecs; the Three.js display uses log-compressed depth for navigability while preserving foreground/background order
